title: Microtasks
definition: The Microtask Queue contains callbacks from Promises (`.then/catch/finally`) and `queueMicrotask()`. It has the highest priority. The event loop will completely drain the entire Microtask Queue before moving to Macrotasks or rendering.
simpleExplanation: Microtasks are emergencies. If a doctor (Event Loop) finishes seeing a patient, they will check for emergencies (Microtasks) and treat ALL of them before calling the next regular patient in the waiting room.

answers.question: Define Microtask Queue.
answers.answer: Microtask Queue is a core mechanism in frontend architectures.

answers.question: What is the main bottleneck for Microtask Queue?
answers.answer: Usually network latency or CPU-bound synchronous tasks blocking the main thread.
